original_ai_output.title_zh: SSOMA称基尔篡权，呼吁启动新的和平进程
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹反对派运动联盟（SSOMA）发表声明，谴责总统萨尔瓦·基尔发动“政变”，称其解散了重振民族团结过渡政府并建立非法的看守政府。SSOMA呼吁开展真正、包容和全面的全国和平进程，并敦促国际与地区各方紧急介入。该组织还拒绝基尔计划中的选举，称其为“虚假选举”。

key_facts.fact: SSOMA谴责总统基尔发动政变并称其篡夺宪法秩序
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: SSOMA condemns the actions of President Kiir and the Sudan People's Liberation Movement in Government (SPLM-IG) and considers this development as a grave political, security and constitutional crisis

key_facts.fact: SSOMA称基尔解散了重振民族团结过渡政府并建立非法看守政府
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: dissolving the Revitalized Transitional Government of National Unity (RTGoNU) and establishing an illegal caretaker administration

key_facts.fact: SSOMA呼吁开展真正、包容和全面的全国和平进程
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: SSOMA calls upon South Sudanese stakeholders, the African Union, IGAD, the United Nations, neighboring states and other international partners to urgently consult on the emerging constitutional and political crisis

key_facts.fact: SSOMA拒绝基尔计划中的选举，称其为虚假选举
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: SSOMA categorically rejects the sham elections being planned by Salva Kiir and the SPLM-IG

uncertainties: SSOMA对基尔发动政变、解散过渡政府等指控尚未获得独立证实
相关声明为SSOMA单方面说法，目前仅一个来源
